name: Gogmagog
subtitle: Grove Guardian
description: Spring roots from the ground Intercepting attacks for your allies whilst defending the grove against invaders.
lore: A great beast of an ogre, Gogmagog is most famous not for his own feats but for his defeat by the hero Corineus. Incensed, mortified, and enraged, Gogmagog now hunts for champions of Avalon and surrounding realms so he might prove his prowess by slaughtering them. Between bouts, he feeds on the flesh of farmers and villagers.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity when hit by an enemy.
